about: The locked pictures for dog-dawn (owner, Oct 5, 2026: 'Pictures are locked as in v6. No more renders unless I ask.'). One entry per image, in beat order; beat 8 has two, shown in sequence (a cut mid-beat in the video). Alt text is model-drafted accessibility text and says how the image was made. Files are local until publication; each is identified by sha256.

images.alt: AI-generated image: a young man in a long cream cable-knit tunic sits alone at a console in a room of pale ice-like crystal; behind frosted glass, two dark faceless figures stand; stars show in the windows.
AI-generated image: through a frosted window of a crystal room, a fire burns among snowy pines at night, and a line of small lights crosses the hills.
AI-generated image: a hand in a cream knit sleeve rests on a glass console; a green heartbeat line runs across it and a thin warm thread of light slips away.

images.made_by: FLUX.2 klein 4B (local), sky filled in code
images.alt: AI-generated image: rows of glowing wireframe drones stand on a grid of light in the dark; one small warm probe moves among them.
AI-generated image: the young man works at a console in the crystal room; behind frosted glass in a corridor stands a dark faceless guard; stars show in the windows.

images.made_by: FLUX.2 klein 4B (local), pre-dawn grade in code
images.alt: AI-generated image: before dawn, soldiers in pale hooded cloaks press colourful patterned sheets onto rows of snow drones at the edge of a forest.
Drawn in code: a printed sheet covered in colourful squiggles, with the word DOG in a giant font across a white band.
AI-generated image: at sunrise, drones covered in colourful patterns plough through the snow between pines, past dark drones that sit still.

images.made_by: FLUX.2 klein 4B (local), overlay drawn in code
images.alt: AI-generated image with a code-drawn overlay: the same moment through an Arctic drone's display, a targeting frame on the nearest drone, labelled DOG.
